Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

Flesh of Marble:
Card Text: Only usable before range is chosen. If the vampire
takes more than 1 damage in a round, excess damage
is prevented, although aggravated damage cannot be
prevented. This lasts for the duration of the combat.
(S) As above, but aggravated damage can be
prevented.

Questions refer to FloM at inferior:
I am struck for 1 aggravated. Can I prevent with Skin of Rock
(ie does aggravated damage cannot be prevented mean that the
minion can in no way prevent aggravated damage or just that the FloM
cannot prevent aggravated damage?)

I am struck for 2 damage. To prevent all damage with indomidability,
do I need to prevent 2 damage, or can I prevent with Flesh of Marble
then prevent the "one point" with 1 indomidability?

Thanks,
-JTP
